# Branding & Visual Preferences

> Every visual preference the owner has expressed. Agents implement **this**, not their own taste.
> Want to change something here? Propose it in `IDEAS.md` and ask. Record the owner's exact words when they comment on visuals.
>
> **Where colors live:** the `THEME TOKENS` block in `src/index.css` (see "Theming" in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`). The starter default is black / white / grayscale with red kept only for danger states. Record approved colors here, then apply them there.
